snippet.title: This Get-Rich-Quick Scheme FOOLED MILLIONS (Tom Vu)
snippet.description:
Tom Vu was a self-proclaimed real estate expert who reached millions through late-night infomercials, pitching his “get rich quick” blueprint. At a time when the idea of fake flexing didn’t even exist, Vu paraded yachts, mansions, and bikini models to sell the dream of fast wealth.

Thousands of people flocked to his seminars, desperate to learn how he claimed to go from refugee immigrant to multimillionaire in just a few short years. But the truth hit hard. For most students, Vu’s “secrets” didn’t work at all. Instead of success, many were left deep in debt — feeling scammed and betrayed.

In many ways, Tom Vu was the blueprint for today’s fake gurus and internet scammers. He was doing it long before Instagram flexers and course sellers came along. Vu showed that flashy cars, beautiful women, and promises of easy millions could be enough to sell people on a dream that didn’t exist.
